title: Filling gaps for the libre sensor
body:
Abbott build their historic data on 15 minutes intervals that start with sensor start time. xDrip stores his data every 5 minutes (not related to sensor start). blukoon, reads his data every 5 minutes, not related to sensor start, a User might scan whenever he wants, possibly in less than 5 minutes interval.
My questions are: 
1) The user has scanned on 12:00 and a data was showed. Now he scanned again on 12:02, what should I show him? A change that will allow xDrip to have a per point data is complicated and dangerous, and not really on the table. Is there a practical way to show him the data of the last scan.
2) The user has scanned after 7 minutes from the last scan, Is there a good way to avoid the 7 minutes gap from the scan.
3) Blukon was not connected for 60 minutes, and is now connected. The per 15 minute data fail is 2 minutes from our last reading, while the last 15 minutes point is 2 minutes from current reading (So putting the last 15 minutes in will reject the current reading).
The trivial solution to these problems is calculating the per 5 minutes data and having xDrip reject points that are more than 4 minutes apart. Does anyone has a better solution?

All ideas are welcomed.

comments.body:
1.) I would recommend to show him the current BG reading of the current timing. This is what all LimiTTer deivces and blucon do.
2.) I dont understand hwat you may mean?
3.) have you had a look on the NFC method @jamorham is using? In the adb log I see some paramters to interpolate BG readings in between the 15 mins avarage values (Akima interpolation?).

As for 1, I don't think that this is what other devices do. There is code in xDrip that blocks packets that are less than 4 minutes apart. This has to be somehow out of band. (for example a message box or something alike.)

As for 2: assume I have a reading at 16:50, 16:55, 17:00
Now it is 17:07 and the user has scanned, I can enter this data, (probably I would say I should), but then my next reading will be 17:07, and the reading of 17:10 will be rejected (not 5 minutes apart).
I'm not sure there is an easy way around it.

3) I'll look at that code and see if I can use it.
